title: ChanceBall
description:
ChanceBall is a 2D volleyball game where quick reactions, good positioning and smart decisions win matches.

Play 1v1 or 2v2 matches online or locally with friends. Learn different hit types, make plays with your teammates and outplay your opponents in fast and exciting rallies.

The main twist: each player can touch the ball up to 4 times, but each team only gets 4 touches in total. With walls and a ceiling keeping the ball in play, every touch could set up an attack, save a rally or cost you the point.

Two Ways to PlayChanceBall Rules

A unique ruleset that changes how volleyball is played.

• Up to 4 touches per player

• Maximum 4 touches per team

• Blocks count as touches

This extends rallies, creates more team play and could add more ways to save the ball.

Volleyball Rules

A traditional volleyball experience.

• 1 touch per player

• Maximum 3 touches per team

• Blocks do not count as touches

Skill-Based Gameplay• Different hit types with unique strengths and trajectories

• Timing and positioning of the ball matters

• Easy to learn but challenging to master

• Rewarding for both solo players and teams

Online and Local MultiplayerCreate private lobbies and play with friends

• Online multiplayer for up to 4 players

• Local multiplayer for up to 4 players

• Mix local and online play. Two players can join the same online match from one PC

• Fill empty slots with AI bots

Ability ClashLooking for something more chaotic?

Ability Clash adds 8 unique abilities that can change the flow of a match while keeping skill and teamwork important.

Use abilities to create openings, save difficult balls or surprise your opponents.

Play Against AIPractice against AI opponents with different difficulty levels.

Each AI has its own playstyle tied to its color. Some focus on teamwork, some play defensively, and others are more aggressive. Try different combinations and see what works best.

Climb the Leaderboard• Global online leaderboard

• Unlock achievements

• Compete against players from around the world

Every touch matters. Make the most of yours.
description_short: The competitive 2D volleyball game. ChanceBall is an intensely strategic sports game where you play out exciting rallies, master unique abilities, and dominate your opponents online.
